segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making the time. I saw your note about adding the support team before the May 20 go-live, so I wanted to walk through seats and timing.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, exactly. We’re at 42 seats today, and we need to add 18. Ideally they’re live the same day as the operations group, not a week later.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s doable. The 18 additional seats would be prorated from May 20 through your current term end, December 31. That comes to $7,860 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that would show as a separate line on the June invoice, or would you issue something right away?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: We can issue it right away if that helps purchasing. It’ll reference the existing agreement and show the prorated seat add-on as its own line item.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Please do that. Our AP team wants the PO tied to the add-on, and they need net 30, same as the original contract.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, same net 30 terms. I’ll send the order form today with 60 total seats, May 20 start for the added users, and December 31 coterm.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. For onboarding, do you need the list of names now, or can we send that after signature?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: After signature is fine. If you can send the user list by May 13, our onboarding lead can get the accounts staged and schedule the admin refresher on May 16.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send the order form to me and copy procurement@ourdomain. I’ll get it signed this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send it over this afternoon and include the invoice timing, net 30 terms, and the May 13 user-list date in the email so everybody has the same details.
